title: SugarCraft — SugarGallery
description: SugarGallery: Poster grids and carousels for media-browsing terminal apps — virtualized paging over large libraries.
ogDescription: Browse-grid widgets for media TUIs: a 2-D virtualized PosterGrid that holds only the cards that have been fetched (sparse, absolute-indexed) and exposes a visible-range window for owner-pulled paging, a Rail carousel, and a renderer-agnostic PosterCard. Immutable.
tagline: Poster grids & rails for media TUIs — virtualized PosterGrid, Rail carousel, PosterCard
